title: Measures to Help Build Stronger Marriages and Families
what_it_is: Measures to Help Build Stronger Marriages and Families

sections.label: Family conflict resolution methods
sections.summary: Asked whether the Ministry will consider alternative resolution methods for family conflicts and how it will help couples build strong marriages and families.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) whether the Ministry will consider alternative resolution methods for family conflicts and how the fallout and repair of family relationships can be better managed for better child and family outcomes; and (b) how will the Ministry proactively and pre-emptively help couples build strong marriages and families.

sections.label: Four DSSAs by MSF
sections.summary: The Ministry of Social and Family Development has set up four DSSAs run by voluntary welfare organisations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Today, the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) has set up four DSSAs, which are run by voluntary welfare organisations.

sections.label: Joint committee on family law
sections.summary: MSF, Ministry of Law and Family Justice Courts will set up a joint committee to study enhancing the family law regime and family dispute resolution.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In this regard, as the Senior Minister of State of Law had earlier mentioned, MSF, Ministry of Law and the Family Justice Courts (FJC) will be setting up a joint committee to study how we can further enhance the family law regime and explore multidisciplinary methods of family dispute resolution and Court-based resolution.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The Committee will also examine how the concepts of restorative and therapeutic justice can be applied more extensively in the context of family dispute resolution.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: This new Committee will start work by the end of this year and will be headed by the Permanent Secretaries of both Ministries, together with the Presiding Judge of FJC.
